messages:
Sofia Ramos: Quick heads-up — CloudAxis reported a perf regression hitting their marketplace listing. They asked for an escalation path that works across our shared channel + their SI. Proposal below.

Mike Chen: thanks. do we have a standard warroom naming convention for partner-facing SEVs?

Sofia Ramos: propose `partner-<partner>-sev<sev>-<yyMMdd>` for the channel and `Zoom` bridge with label `Redwood x <partner> - SEV`. also the shared channel should be read-only for partner execs until a warroom is declared.

Ana Patel: +1 on naming. Also add runbook tag so we can auto-attach runbook on warroom creation.

Kevin O'Neill: what about oncall ownership? who pings our SRE vs. partnerships lead?

Sofia Ramos: sequence suggestion: 1) partner declares SEV on their side -> post in shared channel and DM `partners-oncall` bot -> `partners-oncall` creates warroom and notifies `eng-sre-oncall` and `solutions-oncall`. keep the first 15 minutes triage in the partner warroom, then escalate to internal SEV channels if we need org-wide involvement.

partners-bot: action: created warroom `partner-cloudaxis-sev1-23061` and Zoom link https://zoom.redwood/example (auto-notified eng-sre-oncall, solutions-oncall, partnerships-oncall)

Ana Patel: config snippet for bot routing (drop into ops/playbooks/partners.yml):
```
route:
  sev1: [eng-sre-oncall, solutions-oncall, partnerships-oncall]
  sev2: [solutions-oncall, partnerships-oncall]
  fallback: [partnerships-leads]
```

Mike Chen: what about access for SI engineers? partners can add them to the shared channel; we shouldn't invite vendor accounts into internal `eng-sre` channel. keep audit trail for any elevated access.

Sofia Ramos: yes — SI folks go into `partner-<partner>-shared` only. For deeper access (logs, traces) open a SOC ticket with justification and expiry. add the SOC ticket link to warroom notes.

Kevin O'Neill: runbook checklist for SEV-1: roles, who owns bridge, who owns customer comms, telemetry links, rollback plan, postmortem owner. Can someone PR that to the runbook repo?

Sofia Ramos: I'll PR now. tagging Ana to add the telemetry links for CloudAxis metrics.

Ana Patel: adding them; also will add a short playbook for "marketplace listing high latency" that includes quick fixes (scale dedicated pool, fail to cheaper model variant, purge KV cache).

Mike Chen: lgtm. let's trial this flow tomorrow with CloudAxis in a dry-run warroom so their SI knows who to ping and how.

Sofia Ramos: sweet. If anyone sees anything missing, add here. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: NOTE: SEV tracking ticket created: #PS-4821 (partners).
